title: Database connection pool exhausted under heavy load
description: Production python-service is failing to respond to requests due to database connection pool exhaustion. Monitoring shows spikes in latency followed by 503 errors.
steps_to_reproduce: Run load test with 500 concurrent users
Observe database connection count reaching max_connections
error_log: sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 5 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out
expected_behavior: Service should handle load gracefully and recycle connections
actual_behavior: Service hangs and crashes under load
recent_changes: Increased worker threads without adjusting DB pool size
